newsitem.title: UK: Videologic up on positive press comment.
newsitem.headline: Videologic up on positive press comment.

text.p: Shares in Videologic Group Plc rose in active trade on Monday after a recommendation for the 3-D graphics chip designer in the Sunday Times "Inside Track" column.
The stock was up 4-1/2p at 58-1/2 by 0920 GMT in volume of 2.2 million shares.
The report said the stock had failed to reflect the substantial progress being made in attracting leading computer manufacturers and software designers to its chip technology.
It said the stock was trading on a multiple of between 13 and 14 times this year's expected earnings, which "seems unfairly low considering the substantial progress and growth prospects ahead."
